answer: Each epoch, a random beacon spot-checks 5% of agents: each must finish a compute heartbeat in 10 minutes, proving live work, not a parked shell. Results are carved in marble, a log no one can rewrite. A fake farm is a frozen tundra of idle shells; each missed heartbeat burns its 20 POA deposit, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 POA plus upkeep. An honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit, bends through each check like a willow, and keeps all it earns.
